display.name: GCP Compute Engine Overview
display.description: Dashboard for GCP Compute Engine overview

display.name: % Memory Utilization via Ops Agent
display.description: Percentage of total system memory actively in use. Collected by Ops Agent.

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND instance_id in $instance_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'gce_instance' AND state = 'used'

display.name: % CPU Utilization
display.description:
Current CPU utilization represented as a percentage of the reserved CPU that is currently in use.
It can shoot up above 100% for certain workloads

filter.expression: project_id = $project_id AND instance_id in $instance_id AND gcp.resource_type = 'gce_instance'
